annotationRationale: Extracting the common factor exposes divisibility by 19. The same-base exponent law justifies the factors left inside the parentheses.
sourceMethod: Follows the first official solution, factoring out the smallest power of 7 and recognizing 57 as a multiple of 19.

review.mathCheck: Factoring gives 7²⁰²⁴(1+7+49)=57·7²⁰²⁴=19(3·7²⁰²⁴). The parenthesized factor is an integer, so the remainder is 0, choice A.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, originally worded adaptation of the first MAA solution 7 on page 3. It uses the same common-power factorization and explicit factor 19, with sufficient intermediate arithmetic.
review.annotationCheck: The assessed factoring and divisibility nodes match the argument; the exponent law is appropriate background. No power-cycle method or additional node is needed.
